chain.label: FAA declined to mandate cargo fire detection/suppression
chain.trigger: the FAA responded...stating that fire/smoke detection and fire extinguishment systems were not cost beneficial...and that it had terminated its rulemaking action to require such systems

chain.label: ValuJet provided inadequate oversight of SabreTech
chain.trigger: ValuJet failed to provide significant on-site quality assurance at SabreTech's Miami facility

chain.label: SabreTech removed oxygen generators without safety caps
chain.trigger: safety caps were never installed on the oxygen generators

caused_by.evidence: ValuJet failed to recognize the need for and coordinate the acquisition of oxygen generator safety caps

chain.label: SabreTech mislabeled and shipped generators as empty parts
chain.trigger: the stock clerk identified the generators as "empty canisters"...no hazardous materials warning label on any of the boxes

caused_by.evidence: the failure of SabreTech to properly prepare, package, and identify the unexpended chemical oxygen generators before presenting them to ValuJet...was causal to the accident

chain.label: ValuJet ramp agents loaded unsecured, mislabeled cargo
chain.trigger: the cargo was not secured, and the cargo compartment had no means for securing the cargo

caused_by.evidence: neither the ValuJet lead ramp agent nor the ramp agent who loaded the boxes were provided with information to indicate the hazardous nature of the COMAT shipment

chain.label: Oxygen generator(s) actuated, igniting cargo fire
chain.trigger: the activation of one or more chemical oxygen generators in the forward cargo compartment of the airplane initiated the fire on ValuJet flight 592

caused_by.evidence: one or more of the oxygen generators likely were actuated at some point after the loading process began, but possibly as late as during the airplane's takeoff roll
it is very likely that had safety caps been installed, the generators would not have activated and the accident would not have occurred

chain.label: Fire burned undetected and damaged wiring
chain.trigger: We got some electrical problem...We're losing everything

caused_by.evidence: the fire had probably already escaped the cargo compartment by 1410:12
the cockpit crew of ValuJet flight 592 had no way of detecting the threat to the safety of the airplane from the in-flight fire until smoke and fumes reached the passenger cabin

chain.label: Fire destroyed floor beams, control cables, engine linkage
chain.trigger: the left side floor beams melted and collapsed, which would likely have affected the control cables

caused_by.evidence: the flight experienced a progressive degradation in the airplane's structural integrity and flight controls

chain.label: Flightcrew lost control of the airplane
chain.trigger: the loss of control was most likely the result of flight control failure from the extreme heat and structural collapse

caused_by.evidence: based on the continuing degradation of flight controls and the damage to cabin floorboards in the area of the flight controls

chain.label: Airplane crashed into the Everglades
chain.trigger: the airplane crashed into the Everglades in a right wing down, nose down attitude

caused_by.evidence: Ground scars and wreckage scatter indicated that the airplane crashed into the Everglades in a right wing down, nose down attitude

chain.label: All 110 aboard killed
chain.trigger: Both pilots, the three flight attendants, and all 105 passengers were killed
